messages.content: You are a helpful assistant that translates C++ code to Python 3 code. The code should reads and writes I/O from the console.

samples.content:
num, den, max_iter = map(int, input().split())
ratio = num / den
best_num, best_den = 1, 1
min_diff = 1e9
eps = 1e-25

if den <= best_den:
    print(f"{num}/{den}")
else:
    for i in range(1, max_iter + 1):
        val = ratio * i
        a1 = int(val // 1)
        a2 = a1 + 1
        diff = abs(ratio - a1 / i)
        if diff < min_diff - eps:
            min_diff = diff
            best_num = a1
            best_den = i
        diff = abs(a2 / i - ratio)
        if diff < min_diff - eps:
            min_diff = diff
            best_num = a2
            best_den = i
    print(f"{best_num}/{best_den}")
